decision.reason: Both own RL routes are implemented and measured, but their first frozen candidates were rejected and the seven-agent championship has only one seed per pair. An external score now would benchmark immature training scale more than the intended internal architecture choices.
next_internal_focus: scale 1v1 self-play and replay diversity beyond the two-game M18A corpus
train new M18A and M18B checkpoints without changing frozen rejected evidence
run a multi-seed M16 league screen before any promotion or external comparison

conditions: at least one new internally trained checkpoint completes a frozen multi-seed 1v1 league with zero candidate faults
the checkpoint is not rejected by the frozen internal promotion gate against the current champion
the external runtime is adapted to the existing player-view NDJSON protocol without hidden-state access
external weights, source revision, adapter argv, seeds and deadlines are content-bound before execution
reopen_gate.allowed_use_after_reopen: benchmark opponent only; teacher labels or fine-tuning require a separate explicit authorization and provenance contract

artifact_policy: external downloads and match artifacts, if later authorized, remain ignored under local-artifacts; this tracked file records only the decision and evidence bindings
